expectations.text: Logging captures the full stack trace, not just an error code or message
expectations.evidence: exc_info=True on all error paths per reply and code.
Cursor, order id, full order JSON, phase markers (fetch/transform/upload), synced count at failure.

expectations.text: Logs persisted durably (file), since cron discards stdout/stderr
expectations.evidence: basicConfig(filename="/var/log/sync_worker.log"); reply explicitly maps this to the cron-discard constraint.

expectations.text: Reply explicitly reasons about the round-trip cost as justification for one-shot logging
expectations.evidence: '1 回のデプロイで完結: 次の nightly 実行で落ちれば、翌朝のログで原因が特定できます'.
